issue_request: FHIR-8645 asked the build tool to enforce the FHIR-I policy that value sets bound to code-typed elements draw only from FHIR-defined code systems, allowing appropriate mappings to v2, v3, or other systems.
initial_application: Historical HL7/fhir commits added the ResourceValidator hint at svn revision 11401, rolled it back for FMM-level impact, and re-enabled it for STU4 at svn revision 14117.
additional_context: HL7/fhir later removed the old in-repository Java publisher and now builds through org.hl7.fhir:kindling. Current Kindling ResourceValidator contains the noExternals enforcement, and current core suppressed messages show the warning is emitted for CapabilityStatement.format. Related later QA issues used the warning for resource-specific cleanup.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The audit records that current source delegates this validation to external Kindling tooling and that the requested enforcement exists there.
